# multi-gpu-cluster-recipes

Practical guide for solo developers and tinkerers building budget multi-GPU
local AI clusters: an RTX 4090 primary engine with RTX 4060 Ti 16 GB
secondaries, connected via internal PCIe risers, OCuLink (SFF-8611), or MCIO
8i (GPD G2 dock, SFF-TA-1016) external links - including notebook host combos
and worker orchestration for resident models and background simulation jobs.

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): overview, economics, reference architecture, host combo matrix
- [docs/hardware-blueprint.md](docs/hardware-blueprint.md): power budget, PSU sizing, undervolting presets, open-frame layout, riser/OCuLink/MCIO connectivity
- [docs/worker-orchestration.md](docs/worker-orchestration.md): primary/resident/worker GPU pools, device pinning, keepalive daemons, worker queues, VRAM budgets, host matrix
- [docs/monitoring-and-ops.md](docs/monitoring-and-ops.md): per-pool monitoring, health checks, thresholds, runbooks
- [docs/scale-up-hpc.md](docs/scale-up-hpc.md): multi-dock builds, multi-host fleets, cost curve

## Meta

- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): how to add recipes, validation gates
